prompts.title: Recent Form Pulse
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 canvas on GoatLab charcoal #101412, roughly 8 seconds across three temporal stages, with the lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles; all on-screen text uses Spanish labels sized for mobile legibility. Editorial variant, opening: kinetic typography — 'FC PORTO' in warm white #edf0e6 slams onto the upper half and 'PSV' in slate #8ca6bf onto the lower half on the beat; the Spanish words 'VICTORIAS', 'EMPATES' and 'DERROTAS' then strobe in lime #c5ed74, one per beat, with rhythmic scale punches, motion-blur echoes and a lime underline whip under the home name; the camera holds a slow push-in with a micro-shake on each hit; no numbers, no axes, no match events. The letters shatter into particles that regroup as bars — this particle handoff is the transition into the statistical block. Statistical variant: a grouped count-bar chart with a shared zero baseline sitting just above the subtitle band; two clusters, 'FC Porto' in lime and 'PSV' in slate, each showing three bars labeled 'Victorias', 'Empates' and 'Derrotas', resolved from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}, all in the single unit 'partidos' on one common scale with faint slate gridlines. Bars grow from the baseline with staggered elastic easing; emphasis drops the non-victory bars to reduced opacity so the victories pair becomes the single focal point. Typography: condensed grotesque for names, tabular figures for resolved values, warm white on charcoal for contrast, lime reserved for the home accent. A sample annotation under each cluster reads 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos' and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos', flagging any unequal samples, with the source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' and the Spanish caption 'Historial reciente; no es un pronóstico'. Exit: bars retract into the baseline, the title wipes upward and the frame settles on charcoal, subtitle band untouched.

prompts.title: Goal Exchange: For and Against
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 canvas on GoatLab charcoal #101412, roughly 8 seconds in three temporal stages, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles, all on-screen text in Spanish labels sized for mobile legibility. Editorial variant, opening: an illustrative vertical football pitch drawn in warm white #edf0e6 line art with the goal at the top of frame; a ball arcs upward leaving a lime #c5ed74 comet trail for FC Porto, then a second ball arcs with a slate #8ca6bf trail for PSV; on arrival each net ripples and the Spanish word 'GOL' pulses once in warm white; the headings 'GOLES A FAVOR' and 'GOLES EN CONTRA' slide in from opposite edges; the camera performs a slow tilt-up following the ball paths; no numbers, no axes, no scoreboard, no invented match events. The balls dissolve into two pairs of rising bars — that dissolve is the transition into the statistical block. Statistical variant: paired vertical bars on one shared scale in the unit 'goles' with a common zero baseline above the subtitle band; left pair for 'FC Porto' — 'Goles a favor' resolved from {{home.gf}} in lime and 'Goles en contra' from {{home.ga}} in outlined slate; right pair for 'PSV' — 'Goles a favor' from {{away.gf}} and 'Goles en contra' from {{away.ga}}, identical scale and baseline so all four heights are directly comparable, with faint slate gridlines and a Spanish legend at top. Bars rise in synchronized pairs with a soft overshoot; emphasis: a warm-white hairline bracket links each team's pair, keeping the attack-versus-concession reading as the single focal point. A sample annotation reads 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos' and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos' beneath the clusters, with the source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro'. Exit: bars sink into the baseline, pitch lines retract to center and the frame cuts on the beat.

prompts.title: Shield Test: Clean Sheets
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 canvas on GoatLab charcoal #101412, roughly 7 seconds in three temporal stages, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles, Spanish labels throughout. Editorial variant, opening: a stylised shield forged from angular lime #c5ed74 strokes materializes center-frame under the name 'FC PORTO' in warm white #edf0e6; incoming slate #8ca6bf energy bolts strike the shield and shatter into sparks — pure defensive energy, no counts, no axes, no match events; the shield then re-forges in slate for 'PSV' while a single bolt slips past and the Spanish heading 'ARCOS EN CERO' stamps in with a heavy impact frame; the camera orbits a few degrees with parallax glow; the shield splits down the middle as the transition into the statistical block. Statistical variant: two single count bars on a shared zero baseline in the unit 'partidos', labeled 'Arcos en cero' — 'FC Porto' resolved from {{home.clean}} in lime and 'PSV' from {{away.clean}} in slate; beneath each bar a slim context strip shows the sample behind the count, 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos' and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos', so the counts are always read against their sample sizes and never converted into rates; faint slate gridlines and the source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' complete the annotation layer. Bars snap upward with a metallic ease; emphasis: a lime ring pulses around the stronger clean-sheet count while the other bar dims, keeping one focal point. Exit: the bars fold back into two half-shield silhouettes that fade to charcoal, subtitle band untouched.

prompts.title: Form Against Shared Fragility
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 canvas on GoatLab charcoal #101412, roughly 9 seconds in three temporal stages, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles, Spanish labels throughout. Editorial variant, opening: a team-reveal duel — 'FC PORTO' assembles from lime #c5ed74 light streaks in the upper half while 'PSV' assembles from slate #8ca6bf streaks in the lower half, both nameplates with warm white #edf0e6 cores; the plates slide together and collide in a particle shockwave; over the impact the Spanish words 'FORMA' (solid warm white) and 'FRAGILIDAD COMPARTIDA' (outlined) interlock, a narrative emphasis on one grounded tension from the data: FC Porto shows more recent victories while both defenses have conceded the same figure; the camera pushes through the collision; no axes, no numbers, no invented events. The particle burst re-forms as chart bars — that burst is the transition into the statistical panel. Statistical variant: two aligned mini-panels, each with its own zero baseline and clearly separated units so nothing is mixed on one axis; left panel 'Victorias' in 'partidos' — 'FC Porto' from {{home.wins}} in lime versus 'PSV' from {{away.wins}} in slate; right panel 'Goles en contra' in 'goles' — 'FC Porto' from {{home.ga}} versus 'PSV' from {{away.ga}}, identical bar styling with faint slate gridlines and a Spanish legend on top. Bars grow simultaneously; emphasis: a warm-white hairline underlines the goals-against pair leveling at the same height while the victories panel shows the gap, one focal point per panel. Sample annotations 'Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos' and 'Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos', the source line 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' and the caption 'Historial reciente; no es un pronóstico' close the layout. Exit: panels slide apart vertically, the hairline snaps and the frame fades to charcoal.
